name: Leader Marina
lines: “Welcome to Palmhaven Town. Relax, nobody here asks questions.”
“My Water team flows around every attack.”
win: “Okay, you made a splash. The Water Badge is yours.”
lose: “Washed out! Come back when the tide turns.”
hint: Leader Marina’s Water team is level 29–31. Grass and Electric moves soak them, and Fire barely makes them steam.

seat.title: Water Badge · 3 of 8
seat.rewardText: a Golden Parachute, 3 Gold Coins and 2 Platinum Coins
seat.unlockText: The path up Mt. Cinderpeak, on the north shore, is open. Bring water.
